cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys, json, collections
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/site')
import ctypes; ctypes.CDLL('/workspace/native/libz.so.1', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
import harness; harness.setup_env()
import gen, formats, pipeline, discovery, reference
stats = collections.Counter()
widths = []
for seed in range(400):
    draft = gen.make_request(seed)
    capacity = draft['capacity']
    info={}
    for spec in draft['releases']:
        m = reference.build_model(spec, capacity)
        info[spec['id']] = (m['mode'], m['entries'])
    request = gen.make_request(seed, info)
    mine = pipeline.execute(formats.validate(json.loads(json.dumps(request))))
    for cat in mine['catalog']:
        stats['releases'] += 1
        stats['kept-' + str(min(len(cat['priority']),3))] += 1
        for cl in cat['clusters']:
            widths.append(max(hi-lo for lo,hi in cl['range']))
        stats['entries-' + ('0' if cat['entries']==0 else ('1' if cat['entries']==1 else 'big'))] += 1
        stats['noise-' + ('y' if cat['noise'] else 'n')] += 1
    for d in mine['decisions']:
        stats[d['reason']] += 1
    for i in mine['installs']:
        stats['install-' + i['status']] += 1
print(dict(stats))
widths.sort()
print('interval spread: p50', widths[len(widths)//2], 'p90', widths[int(len(widths)*0.9)], 'max', widths[-1])
PYEOF
